verses.original: הַצַּדִּ֣יק אָבָ֔ד וְאֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ שָׂ֣ם עַל־ לֵ֑ב וְאַנְשֵׁי־ חֶ֤סֶד נֶֽאֱסָפִים֙ בְּאֵ֣ין מֵבִ֔ין כִּֽי־ מִפְּנֵ֥י הָרָעָ֖ה נֶאֱסַ֥ף הַצַּדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣad·dîq ’ā·ḇāḏ wə·’ên ’îš śām ‘al- lêḇ wə·’an·šê- ḥe·seḏ ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄îm bə·’ên mê·ḇîn kî- mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āh ne·’ĕ·sap̄ haṣ·ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: The righteous perish and no one takes it to heart devout men are taken away while no one considers that the righteous are taken away from the presence of evil

verses.original: יָב֣וֹא שָׁל֔וֹם יָנ֖וּחוּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם הֹלֵ֖ךְ נְכֹחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇō·w šā·lō·wm yā·nū·ḥū ‘al- miš·kə·ḇō·w·ṯām hō·lêḵ nə·ḵō·ḥōw
verses.literal: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace they find rest lying down in death

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֥ם קִרְבוּ־ הֵ֖נָּה בְּנֵ֣י עֹנְנָ֑ה זֶ֥רַע מְנָאֵ֖ף וַתִּזְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem qir·ḇū- hên·nāh bə·nê ‘ō·nə·nāh ze·ra‘ mə·nā·’êp̄ wat·tiz·neh
verses.literal: But come here you sons of a sorceress you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes

verses.original: עַל־ מִי֙ תִּתְעַנָּ֔גוּ עַל־ מִ֛י תַּרְחִ֥יבוּ פֶ֖ה תַּאֲרִ֣יכוּ לָשׁ֑וֹן הֲלֽוֹא־ אַתֶּ֥ם יִלְדֵי־ פֶ֖שַׁע זֶ֥רַע שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- mî tiṯ·‘an·nā·ḡū ‘al- mî tar·ḥî·ḇū p̄eh ta·’ă·rî·ḵū lā·šō·wn hă·lō·w- ’at·tem yil·ḏê- p̄e·ša‘ ze·ra‘ šā·qer
verses.literal: Whom are you mocking At whom do you sneer . . . and stick out your tongue Are you not children of transgression offspring of deceit

verses.original: הַנֵּֽחָמִים֙ בָּֽאֵלִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֑ן שֹׁחֲטֵ֤י הַיְלָדִים֙ בַּנְּחָלִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת סְעִפֵ֥י הַסְּלָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: han·nê·ḥā·mîm bā·’ê·lîm ta·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān šō·ḥă·ṭê hay·lā·ḏîm ban·nə·ḥā·lîm ta·ḥaṯ sə·‘i·p̄ê has·sə·lā·‘îm
verses.literal: who burn with lust among the oaks under every luxuriant tree who slaughter your children in the valleys under the clefts of the rocks

verses.original: בְּחַלְּקֵי־ נַ֣חַל חֶלְקֵ֔ךְ הֵ֥ם הֵ֖ם גּוֹרָלֵ֑ךְ גַּם־ לָהֶ֞ם שָׁפַ֥כְתְּ נֶ֙סֶךְ֙ הֶעֱלִ֣ית מִנְחָ֔ה הַ֥עַל אֵ֖לֶּה אֶנָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥal·lə·qê- na·ḥal ḥel·qêḵ hêm hêm gō·w·rā·lêḵ gam- lā·hem šā·p̄aḵt ne·seḵ he·‘ĕ·lîṯ min·ḥāh ha·‘al ’êl·leh ’en·nā·ḥêm
verses.literal: Your portion is among the smooth stones of the valley indeed, they . . . are your lot Even to them you have poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering Should I relent because of these

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר־ גָּבֹ֙הַּ֙ וְנִשָּׂ֔א שַׂ֖מְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵ֑ךְ גַּם־ שָׁ֥ם עָלִ֖ית לִזְבֹּ֥חַ זָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al har- gā·ḇō·ah wə·niś·śā śamt miš·kā·ḇêḵ gam- šām ‘ā·lîṯ liz·bō·aḥ zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed and there you went up to offer sacrifices

verses.original: וְאַחַ֤ר הַדֶּ֙לֶת֙ וְהַמְּזוּזָ֔ה שַׂ֖מְתְּ זִכְרוֹנֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י מֵאִתִּ֞י גִּלִּ֣ית וַֽתַּעֲלִ֗י הִרְחַ֤בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵךְ֙ וַתִּכְרָת־ לָ֣ךְ מֵהֶ֔ם אָהַ֥בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבָ֖ם יָ֥ד חָזִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar had·de·leṯ wə·ham·mə·zū·zāh śamt ziḵ·rō·w·nêḵ kî mê·’it·tî gil·lîṯ wat·ta·‘ă·lî hir·ḥaḇt miš·kā·ḇêḵ wat·tiḵ·rāṯ- lāḵ mê·hem ’ā·haḇt miš·kā·ḇām yāḏ ḥā·zîṯ
verses.literal: Behind the door and doorpost you have set up your memorial Forsaking Me . . . you uncovered your bed you climbed up and opened it wide And you have made a pact with those whose bed you have loved you have gazed upon their nakedness

verses.original: וַתָּשֻׁ֤רִי לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וַתַּרְבִּ֖י רִקֻּחָ֑יִךְ וַתְּשַׁלְּחִ֤י צִרַ֙יִךְ֙ עַד־ מֵ֣רָחֹ֔ק וַתַּשְׁפִּ֖ילִי עַד־ שְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·šu·rî lam·me·leḵ baš·še·men wat·tar·bî riq·qu·ḥā·yiḵ wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥî ṣi·rayḵ ‘aḏ- mê·rā·ḥōq wat·taš·pî·lî ‘aḏ- šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: You went to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes You have sent your envoys a great distance you have descended . . . even to Sheol itself

verses.original: בְּרֹ֤ב דַּרְכֵּךְ֙ יָגַ֔עַתְּ לֹ֥א אָמַ֖רְתְּ נוֹאָ֑שׁ חַיַּ֤ת יָדֵךְ֙ מָצָ֔את עַל־ כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א חָלִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ dar·kêḵ yā·ḡa·‘at lō ’ā·mart nō·w·’āš ḥay·yaṯ yā·ḏêḵ mā·ṣāṯ ‘al- kên lō ḥā·lîṯ
verses.literal: You are wearied by your many journeys but you did not say There is no hope You found renewal of your strength therefore . . . you did not grow weak

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִ֞י דָּאַ֤גְתְּ וַתִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּ֣י תְכַזֵּ֔בִי וְאוֹתִי֙ לֹ֣א זָכַ֔רְתְּ לֹא־ שַׂ֖מְתְּ עַל־ לִבֵּ֑ךְ הֲלֹ֨א אֲנִ֤י מַחְשֶׁה֙ וּמֵ֣עֹלָ֔ם וְאוֹתִ֖י לֹ֥א תִירָֽאִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- mî dā·’aḡt wat·tî·rə·’î kî ṯə·ḵaz·zê·ḇî wə·’ō·w·ṯî lō zā·ḵart lō- śamt ‘al- lib·bêḵ hă·lō ’ă·nî maḥ·šeh ū·mê·‘ō·lām wə·’ō·w·ṯî lō ṯî·rā·’î
verses.literal: Whom have you dreaded and feared so that you lied and failed to remember Me or take this to heart Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אַגִּ֖יד צִדְקָתֵ֑ךְ וְאֶֽת־ מַעֲשַׂ֖יִךְ וְלֹ֥א יוֹעִילֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’ag·gîḏ ṣiḏ·qā·ṯêḵ wə·’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śa·yiḵ wə·lō yō·w·‘î·lūḵ
verses.literal: I will expose your righteousness and your works and they will not profit you

verses.original: בְּזַֽעֲקֵךְ֙ יַצִּילֻ֣ךְ קִבּוּצַ֔יִךְ וְאֶת־ כֻּלָּ֥ם יִשָּׂא־ ר֖וּחַ יִקַּח־ הָ֑בֶל וְהַחוֹסֶ֥ה בִי֙ יִנְחַל־ אֶ֔רֶץ וְיִירַ֖שׁ הַר־ קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·za·‘ă·qêḵ yaṣ·ṣî·luḵ qib·bū·ṣa·yiḵ wə·’eṯ- kul·lām yiś·śā- rū·aḥ yiq·qaḥ- hā·ḇel wə·ha·ḥō·w·seh ḇî yin·ḥal- ’e·reṣ wə·yî·raš har- qāḏ·šî
verses.literal: When you cry out let your companies of idols deliver you Yet the wind will carry off all of them a breath will take them away But he who seeks refuge in Me will inherit the land and possess My holy mountain

verses.original: וְאָמַ֥ר סֹֽלּוּ־ סֹ֖לּוּ פַּנּוּ־ דָ֑רֶךְ הָרִ֥ימוּ מִכְשׁ֖וֹל מִדֶּ֥רֶךְ עַמִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar sōl·lū- sōl·lū pan·nū- ḏā·reḵ hā·rî·mū miḵ·šō·wl mid·de·reḵ ‘am·mî
verses.literal: And it will be said Build it up build it up prepare the way take every obstacle out of the way of My people

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר רָ֣ם וְנִשָּׂ֗א שֹׁכֵ֥ן עַד֙ וְקָד֣וֹשׁ שְׁמ֔וֹ מָר֥וֹם וְקָד֖וֹשׁ אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹן וְאֶת־ דַּכָּא֙ וּשְׁפַל־ ר֔וּחַ לְהַחֲיוֹת֙ ר֣וּחַ שְׁפָלִ֔ים וּֽלְהַחֲי֖וֹת לֵ֥ב נִדְכָּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar rām wə·niś·śā šō·ḵên ‘aḏ wə·qā·ḏō·wōš šə·mōw mā·rō·wm wə·qā·ḏō·wōš ’eš·kō·wn wə·’eṯ- dak·kā ū·šə·p̄al- rū·aḥ lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ rū·aḥ šə·p̄ā·lîm ū·lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ lêḇ niḏ·kā·’îm
verses.literal: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up who inhabits eternity whose name is Holy I dwell in a high and holy place and with the oppressed and humble in spirit to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְעוֹלָם֙ אָרִ֔יב וְלֹ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח אֶקְּצ֑וֹף כִּי־ ר֙וּחַ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֣י יַֽעֲט֔וֹף וּנְשָׁמ֖וֹת אֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ā·rîḇ wə·lō lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’eq·qə·ṣō·wp̄ kî- rū·aḥ mil·lə·p̄ā·nay ya·‘ă·ṭō·wp̄ ū·nə·šā·mō·wṯ ’ă·nî ‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: For I will not accuse you forever . . . nor will I always be angry for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me the breath of life I have made

verses.original: בַּעֲוֺ֥ן בִּצְע֛וֹ קָצַ֥פְתִּי וְאַכֵּ֖הוּ הַסְתֵּ֣ר וְאֶקְצֹ֑ף וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ שׁוֹבָ֖ב בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·wōn biṣ·‘ōw qā·ṣap̄·tî wə·’ak·kê·hū has·têr wə·’eq·ṣōp̄ way·yê·leḵ šō·w·ḇāḇ bə·ḏe·reḵ lib·bōw
verses.literal: I was enraged by his sinful greed so I struck him and hid My face in anger yet he kept turning back to the desires of his heart

verses.original: דְּרָכָ֥יו רָאִ֖יתִי וְאֶרְפָּאֵ֑הוּ וְאַנְחֵ֕הוּ וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֧ם נִֽחֻמִ֛ים ל֖וֹ וְלַאֲבֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: də·rā·ḵāw rā·’î·ṯî wə·’er·pā·’ê·hū wə·’an·ḥê·hū wa·’ă·šal·lêm ni·ḥu·mîm lōw wə·la·’ă·ḇê·lāw
verses.literal: I have seen his ways but I will heal him I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners

verses.original: בּוֹרֵ֖א נוּב שְׂפָתָ֑יִם שָׁל֨וֹם׀ שָׁל֜וֹם לָרָח֧וֹק וְלַקָּר֛וֹב אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה וּרְפָאתִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w·rê nūḇ śə·p̄ā·ṯā·yim šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm lā·rā·ḥō·wq wə·laq·qā·rō·wḇ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ū·rə·p̄ā·ṯîw
verses.literal: bringing praise to their lips Peace peace to those far and near says the LORD and I will heal them

verses.original: וְהָרְשָׁעִ֖ים כַּיָּ֣ם נִגְרָ֑שׁ כִּ֤י הַשְׁקֵט֙ לֹ֣א יוּכָ֔ל וַיִּגְרְשׁ֥וּ מֵימָ֖יו רֶ֥פֶשׁ וָטִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rə·šā·‘îm kay·yām niḡ·rāš kî haš·qêṭ lō yū·ḵāl way·yiḡ·rə·šū mê·māw re·p̄eš wā·ṭîṭ
verses.literal: But the wicked are like the storm-tossed sea for it cannot be still . . . and its waves churn up mire and muck

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהַ֖י לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ên šā·lō·wm ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hay lā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: There is no peace says my God for the wicked
